what: Versions of the Tibi engine: the voice service's modules (prompts, routing rules, turn-taking, speech) and the models they use. services/sme_interviewer/engine.py computes the fingerprint; a test fails when the engine changes without a new version here.

versions.changes: Baseline: the engine as delivered up to 26 September 2026, when versions started. Small talk, product answers from approved records with citations, product and governance interviews, Higgs voice.

Small talk: a question handed back (“So, how about you?”) is answered about Tibi itself, not from its product record; asked how it is (“How's your day going?”), Tibi answers about itself first; one question per reply, ending the reply; the first letter capitalised; a short answer (“No.”) taken at face value; an off-limits topic is declined and never sent to the product records. Start-up: the conversation model's warm-up has a 150 s limit with a plain message, and a second conversation is refused with the reason. Logs: each turn in the conversation log, the service's lifecycle in the activity log, timestamps on the service log, and “I've finished” timings no longer lost.

Sales rehearsal: Tibi observes the meeting and answers only when asked (Ask Tibi, the T key, or its name when listening for it): what the pitch has missed, the last point more simply, the customer's question answered, an example for this customer. Replies are grounded, under 300 characters and never end with a question. Meeting lines are context, never knowledge, and kept only when chosen. Name activation with the recogniser's spellings of the name, an echo guard for Tibi's own voice, and immediate mute.
